question: The window now needs 2 repaints, but only 1 is allowed. What happens?
context: The window is AABAB: 5 tiles, 3 of them A, so 2 repaints.

choices.label: Drop the leftmost tile and keep the size at 4
choices.feedback: Right. We only care about beating the best of 4, so the window keeps its size and slides forward instead of shrinking.

choices.label: Shrink until it needs at most 1 repaint
choices.feedback: Shrinking below 4 can never beat the best we already have. Sliding keeps the size, which is all that matters.

choices.label: Start a new window at this tile
choices.feedback: That throws away tiles that may be part of a long stretch. Slide by one tile instead.
